changes: Finite F32 logits with T>1 are half-scaled before centering; raw TopK ranking preserves tiny distinctions. T<=1 retains its original graph.
The original Session can be restored during an already-started turn without resetting request key, input offset, RNG, observation or output delivery.
A complete-turn checkpoint is a recovery shortcut only when it covers the current committed ledger; stale or state-only boundaries rebuild through the original model.

sampling.reference: F64 logistic oracle, probability absolute tolerance 3e-6; raw subnormal TopK winner separately checked.
sampling.process_history: Two initial DLL-discovery failures are retained as environment failures, not numerical evidence. Baseline wide case failed after DLL discovery was corrected; old candidate passed 5 tests; final candidate passed all 6.
sampling.limitation: The baseline test TU predates the final tiny-ranking case. Its wide-range test body is unchanged; final source and baseline source are both archived.

EOF_observed.basis: All four facts are asserted before the PASS line; window state beyond the asserted original key is not separately serialized.
